title: 5.5.11 Challenges: Make it yours
description: The game is complete. Change one rule of your own: a snake that speeds up as it eats, a best score that survives a loss, or a fix for the quick double-turn. Pick one, or invent one.

steps.title: Pick a rule and change it
steps.instructions: Choose one of the three challenges on the page above, or invent a rule of your own. Start from the game in the editor.
hints: Whatever you pick, press R afterwards and check the game still starts cleanly.

steps.title: Name what you changed
steps.instructions: Write one sentence in the notes under the editor saying what your rule is and what would happen if you removed it.
hints: A rule is something the game decides. 'The snake speeds up with each food' is a rule; 'I changed a colour' is not.

requirements.title: The snake speeds up as it eats
requirements.description: The beat is a variable that gets shorter. Help: 5.5.2 (Reading: A world on a grid)

requirements.title: The best score survives a loss
requirements.description: A second number is kept across rounds and updated when the score beats it. Help: 5.3.10 (Lab: Lose, and start again)

requirements.title: A turn waits for the next step
requirements.description: The key stores the turn, and the step applies it. Help: 5.5.4 (Lab: Steer it)
